title: 窓辺の留守番
theme: 留守番中、この子は窓から私の帰りを探していた

slides.text:
昼の2時、見守りカメラに
映っていたもの
slides.scene: Afternoon: the dog sits on a cushion by a large living-room window, front paws on the sill, gazing out at the street, alone in the quiet apartment. Soft daylight.
slides.shot: centered, the dog seen three-quarters from behind at the window

slides.text:
仕事の合間に、
こっそりアプリを開いた
slides.scene: The owner's hands hold a phone at an office desk; the screen shows only a soft glowing blur, no text.
slides.shot: close-up of hands and phone over a desk

slides.text:
午前中は、
お気に入りの毛布で寝ていた
slides.scene: Morning in the empty apartment: the dog asleep curled on a soft blue blanket on the sofa.
slides.shot: medium shot, calm morning light

slides.text:
よかった、
今日もおとなしくしてる
slides.scene: At an office desk, the owner seen from behind holds a phone; on the phone screen is a small drawing of the dog curled up asleep on a blue blanket at home. The dog is NOT in the office, only on the phone screen.
slides.shot: over the owner's shoulder, the phone screen clearly visible

slides.text:
でも昼を過ぎると、
この子は窓辺に移った
slides.scene: The dog walking across the living room toward the bright window, the empty blanket left behind.
slides.shot: wide view of the living room

slides.text:
外を通る人を、
ひとりずつ目で追っている
slides.scene: The dog at the window watching a distant person with an umbrella-less figure walking on the street below; only tiny faraway figures, no faces.
slides.shot: from inside, over the dog's shoulder to the street

slides.text:
足音がするたびに、
耳がぴくっと動く
slides.scene: Close-up of the dog's ear lifting alertly, eyes wide, at the window.
slides.shot: close-up of the dog's head in profile

slides.text:
私の帰りを、
窓から探しているんだ
slides.scene: The dog pressing its nose to the window glass, looking down the street with hopeful eyes; the glass shows no reflections.
slides.shot: close-up, the dog in profile against the glass

slides.text:
その日は仕事を片づけて、
定時で会社を出た
slides.scene: The owner seen from behind leaving an office building at dusk, coat on, walking briskly.
slides.shot: wide view from behind

slides.text:
駅から家までの道を、
少しだけ早足で歩く
slides.scene: A residential street at dusk with warm streetlights; the owner seen from behind walking quickly in a charcoal coat with a black bag.
slides.shot: wide view from behind

slides.text:
角を曲がると、
窓に小さな影が見えた
slides.scene: From the street at dusk: an apartment window glowing warmly with the small silhouette of the dog sitting in it.
slides.shot: looking up from the street at the window

slides.text:
ガラス越しに、
しっぽがちぎれそうに揺れている
slides.scene: Close-up through the window from outside: the dog's whole body wagging, tail a blur, mouth open in a smile.
slides.shot: close-up of the dog behind the window glass

slides.text:
私に気づいた瞬間、
窓から姿が消えた
slides.scene: The empty windowsill with the cushion still dented, the dog already gone, a blur of fur leaving the frame.
slides.shot: medium shot of the window from inside

slides.text:
玄関のドアの向こうで、
足音が待ちかまえていた
slides.scene: Inside the entrance: the dog waits right at the front door, bouncing on its paws, looking up at the door handle.
slides.shot: low angle from the entrance floor

slides.text:
ただいま、の声より先に、
飛びついてきた
slides.scene: The door opens; the dog leaps up at the owner's legs in a charcoal coat hem and outdoor shoes.
slides.shot: low angle, owner's legs only

slides.text:
この窓辺で待つ日々も、
いつか思い出になるのかな
slides.scene: Evening: the dog asleep on the cushion by the window, soft lamplight, peaceful.
slides.shot: medium shot, warm and calm

slides.text:
だったら今を、
ちゃんと覚えておきたい
slides.scene: The owner's hands holding the dog's face gently, the dog's eyes half-closed with contentment.
slides.shot: close-up of hands and the dog's face

slides.text:
帰る時間を、
この子に約束しよう
slides.scene: The owner, seen from behind, crouches at the window beside the dog and points toward the street, as if showing the way home.
slides.shot: from behind the owner and the dog at the window

slides.text:
窓の向こうで待つ顔に、
早く会えるように
slides.scene: Close-up of the dog at the window at dusk, eyes bright, looking toward the viewer.
slides.shot: close-up portrait at the window

slides.text:
あなたの子は、
留守番中なにをしていますか？
slides.scene: Show the dog sitting alone on the sofa by the window at night, seen from behind, looking out at the city lights; the owner must be absent from the scene.
slides.shot: from behind the sofa

caption:
窓の向こうで、この子はずっと私の帰りを探していた。
あなたの子は、留守番中なにをしていますか？
youtube_title: 昼の2時、見守りカメラに映っていたもの
self_review: 留守番させることを責めない。決意は『帰る時間を約束する』という本人の小さな行動。『いつか』は16枚目の1回だけで、思い出になるという穏やかな表現。
